card.name: Words leading into virus and infection terms
card.fires_on: Words just before a named virus or disease: "including", "contracting", "transmit", "spread of", or the "v" in H3N2v. Also the "UTE" in capitalized "SERIOUS ACUTE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS".

modes.label: Transmission wording before a virus
modes.description: A verb or linking word about spreading or catching disease, right before a virus or disease name.
modes.example: The risk of humans<< contracting>> H5N1 remains very low.

modes.label: Warning heading in capitals
modes.description: The "UTE" piece of ACUTE in the capitalized allergy warning on cephalosporin labels.

card.plain: It lights up on words that lead into talk of viruses spreading or serious allergic reaction headings.
